description: Provider-free generic AI package for static UI route DOM snapshots, evidence-report projection, viewport matrices, visual diff budgets, accessibility summaries, artifact URI manifests, redaction policy, static asset policy, and browser clean skips.
test_gates: route DOM snapshot fixtures decode without launching a browser
evidence-report projection maps artifact, snapshot, warning, and accessibility refs into UI snapshot fixtures
viewport matrix and visual diff budgets are deterministic fixture data
accessibility summaries are static DOM summaries with zero live audits
artifact URI manifest allows only fixture and artifact schemes
redaction policy runs before hashing and forbids credential output patterns
static asset policy forbids remote assets and remote fonts
browser absence produces clean-skip metadata instead of failure

no_built_in_guarantee.statement: Leia core does not provide built-in leia-generic-ai-ui-snapshot-evaluator browser automation or visual diffing; this provider-free package boundary owns UI snapshot, evidence-report projection, viewport, diff budget, accessibility summary, artifact URI, redaction, static asset, and browser clean-skip contracts.

credentials.policy: No credentials are declared by leia-generic-ai-ui-snapshot-evaluator; provider credentials belong only to provider-specific adapter packages behind explicit capability gates.
